responseChannel: named Central release owner through protected environment only
neverProvideInChatEvidenceOrGit: private key, seed phrase, recovery material or account secret
approved test account address unless a named operator explicitly authorizes its redacted evidence form
Apple certificate, profile, P12 password, notary key or signing secret
Android keystore bytes, alias password or signing secret
relay authentication material or session symmetric key

runtimeContract.missingInputBehavior: PRIVATE_SERVICE_DEGRADED; Standard EIP-1193 remains independent; no relay, pairing, account or signer authority is created

namespace.accountBoundary: exactly one approved lowercase 0x account resolved from the existing signer binding

protectedInputs.name: YNX_WALLETCONNECT_PROJECT_ID
protectedInputs.binding: Apple Info.plist YNXWalletConnectProjectID and Android __YNX_WALLETCONNECT_RUNTIME__.projectId or build-time EXPO_PUBLIC_WALLETCONNECT_PROJECT_ID
protectedInputs.validation: exact 32 lowercase hexadecimal characters; real Reown project allowlist receipt required

protectedInputs.name: YNX_WALLETCONNECT_APP_GROUP
protectedInputs.binding: Apple Info.plist YNXWalletConnectAppGroup and signed com.apple.security.application-groups entitlement
protectedInputs.validation: signed application-group receipt must match both eligible Apple targets

protectedInputs.name: YNX_WALLETCONNECT_KEYCHAIN_ACCESS_GROUP
protectedInputs.binding: existing Wallet Keychain signer/persistence identity; no new secret store
protectedInputs.validation: signed entitlement and add/read/delete receipt on eligible target; source string alone is insufficient

protectedInputs.name: YNX_WALLETCONNECT_APPROVED_ACCOUNT_HANDLE
protectedInputs.binding: resolves inside the existing native signer or managed Android Wallet account selector
protectedInputs.validation: must resolve to one Testnet 0x account after explicit approval; handle is not an address or key

protectedInputs.name: YNX_WALLETCONNECT_TEST_TX_POLICY
protectedInputs.binding: operator-approved recipient handle, maximum native value, maximum gas and expiry
protectedInputs.validation: chain eip155:6423 only; zero production value; every send requires a separate immediate confirmation

protectedInputs.name: YNX_WALLETCONNECT_DAPP_FIRST_PARTY_ORIGIN
protectedInputs.validation: origin only, no credentials, query or fragment; independently opened target URL must remain within this origin

allowedDAppOrigins.rule: Each exact URL must be named by the operator and independently opened. Redirects, subdomains, lookalikes, fixtures and copied pages are rejected.

required: eligible physical-device or isolated emulator install
secure persistence and exact package/version readback

orderedExecution: named Central owner issues one path-scoped, time-bounded execution lease
executor confirms every protected input and install target without printing values
build exact source with runtime default-off and inject protected bindings only inside the protected job
install and prove cold launch plus second launch before pairing
independently open first-party, Uniswap, OpenSea and Safe exact targets
capture proposal and execute one approve plus one reject path
read back exact eip155:6423 and the approved redacted 0x account
restart Wallet and prove session restore without a new approval
with separate immediate confirmation execute personal_sign, EIP-712 and bounded Testnet send
disconnect and revoke; prove session, pending requests and account authority are purged
remove protected material and publish only the redacted evidence envelope

identity: YNX identity distinct from official signed MetaMask comparator
relayLifecycle: relay connected receipt without token or symmetric key
proposal reject request ID and 4001/no-authority result
restored session topic digest after process restart
requestLifecycle: personal_sign request ID and result digest
EIP-712 request ID, domain chain and result digest
Testnet send request ID, bounded policy digest, transaction hash and confirmed receipt
accountsChanged, chainChanged and disconnect event order
dapps: visible DApp name/origin and approval decision for each

releaseRule: The request is executable only after every protected input, signed target and lease receipt is satisfied. Missing inputs keep the affected gates false and must never be replaced by fixtures, fabricated IDs, raw keys, source/CI claims or MetaMask impersonation.
